title: Working with Louis Armstrong, Jelly Roll Morton and Bennie Moten
summary: She liked working with everyone, remembers Jelly Roll as older and distant, and says she sang with Bennie Moten's band.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Did you like working with Louis Armstrong?

Yeah, I did. I liked working with everybody I worked with. I don't know nobody that I worked with that I disliked. In fact, I loves everybody anyhow. I love people. And I can work with anybody because I love people.
When we were talking about that big O.K. night, was Jelly Roll Morton there? Do you remember if he was there or not?
I remember Jelly Roll Morton, but he was a older man than I was, you know.
And I never could have nothing, you know, no say-so over him, you know.
Did you ever talk to him?
Uh-huh. I don't remember nothing with
How about Bennie Moten? Was he there that night?

I knew Bennie Moten and sang with his band (unintelligible) because just like I say, the man I was going with, he wasn't jealous (unintelligible). But I didn't want him to think I wanted somebody else and I would never let him see me talking to nobody, you know. If he wasn't around, I would talk. But if he was around, I wouldn't say nothing or talk or nothing. But if he wasn't -- nobody around, I'd (unintelligible). I would really ________ when he wasn't around. Yeah, when me and Bonnie get together, (unintelligible).
